correctness.rationale: For ||u||=1, K²=I+3uu^T and H=2I+4uu^T. Each 2x2 block K_j=diag(1+s_j,1), B_j=diag(q(1+s_j)(q(1+s_j)+1),q(q+1)); q different positive s_j=j²/S give q different poles d_j=2/beta_j in active diagonal-plus-positive-rank-one C_a. Secular interlacing yields q simple roots, and Jensen gives F(eta0)=1-2(q+1)Σ[2q+1+q*s_j]^-1 <=1-q<0 so no collision with inactive eta0. Every active eigenvector has nonzero first coordinate; symmetrically transformed b also has inactive e2 projection, giving exact Krylov grade q+1. For homogeneous sj=1/q active sector has only two levels, inactive one more. Independent symbolic rational F(eta0) and qxq Krylov rank checks q=2..8; exact arithmetic proof covers all q.
